description: Canonical binding (binding_canonical route, borromean words, proton q0) under the convention-D Markov weight (control) and two full-tower partition measures — Molien f·q^-κ·dim_q/[n]_q! and self-normalised quantum Plancherel dim_q²/D² — side by side, with the TL-quotient support fraction of each. EXPLORATORY: neither arm is adopted or wired; arms are NOT ranked by accuracy (anti-fit directive).

data.trace_slot: tr(x) = Σ_λ (mu_λ/f^λ) χ^λ(x); tr(1) = Σ mu = 1

functionals.B_log: E_0·log(|tr(W_free)|/|tr(W_atom)|), E_0 = m_e/(q0(q0−1))  [binding_log_free_energy route, reported alongside]

data.molien_twist_note: Owner wrote f·dim_q/[n]_q!; the Lean-proved normalised form (molienSum_eq_qFactorial) carries q^-κ_λ. The twisted form is used; molien_untwisted_sum records the untwisted total.
data.vanishing_trace_note: Where |tr| < 1e-40 the trace is zero to the 50-dps characters' resolution and B_log is reported None (undefined), not as a number. Consistent with the Molien measure being the regular/symmetrising trace decomposition (identity-coefficient functional), per computations/probes/phi_k_weight_family_discriminator.py §A3 — recorded as consistency, not proved here.
